name: The Agency
summary: A roster of AI agent personas for software teams, from frontend and backend specialists to SRE, marketing and sales roles.
description: A growing collection of AI agent personalities, each a markdown file with identity and personality, mission and workflows, technical deliverables and success metrics. Agents are grouped into divisions — engineering, design, paid media, sales, marketing, product, project management and testing — and install into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and more, with an optional desktop app for browsing the roster.
